changelog.summary: Fixes the Generic CMS owner Admin regression in Qortal Hub on Android: release builds now verify ownership against the hosting node origin instead of a build-time localhost default, and the CMS adds an explicit fail-closed Connect owner account recovery action.

desktop.changelog: Rebuilt with the corrected Generic CMS template bundled in the engine. No desktop source change; the version is bumped because the package contents change.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Publisher artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.2.

cms.changelog: Owner Admin restored on Qortal Hub Android: ownership verification uses the hosting node origin, no longer a build-time localhost URL. Adds Connect owner account and precise registry-unavailable recovery guidance while keeping fail-closed authorization.
